name: flowchart-ai-trailer
description: Motion-design trailer for Flowchart AI, built with Remotion. Self-contained: the app's build, tests and deploy ignore this folder.

scripts.studio: npm run assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts Trailer out/flowchart-ai-trailer.mp4 --muted && node scripts/mux-audio.mjs out/flowchart-ai-trailer.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts TrailerVertical out/flowchart-ai-trailer-vertical.mp4 --muted && node scripts/mux-audio.mjs out/flowchart-ai-trailer-vertical.mp4
scripts.render:poster: npm run assets && remotion still src/index.ts Poster out/flowchart-ai-trailer-poster.png
scripts.render:og: npm run assets && remotion still src/index.ts OgImage out/og-image.png && remotion still src/index.ts OgImageMcp out/og-image-mcp.png
scripts.render:all: npm run music && npm run render && npm run render:vertical && npm run render:poster && npm run qa
